chapters.title: The Testing Effect: Strengthening Memory Through Active Recall
chapters.titleZh: 测试效应：通过主动回忆强化记忆

paragraphs.en: A Neuroscience Hack for Building a Powerful Memory
paragraphs.zh: 一种增强记忆力的神经科学技巧

paragraphs.en: I used to force myself to remember what I had learned by constantly rereading the material. But I eventually realized that this was one of the least effective ways to retain information.
paragraphs.zh: 过去，我总是通过不断重复阅读材料，试图强迫自己记住学过的内容。但后来我意识到，这其实是一种效率很低的记忆方式。

paragraphs.en: Neuroscience and cognitive psychology research have shown that actively trying to recall information from memory helps it stick far better than simply reading the same material over and over again.
paragraphs.zh: 神经科学和认知心理学研究表明，主动尝试从记忆中提取信息，比一遍又一遍地重复阅读同样的材料，更有助于巩固记忆。

paragraphs.en: This phenomenon is known as the testing effect.
paragraphs.zh: 这种现象被称为测试效应（Testing Effect）。

paragraphs.en: So, after reading something, here is exactly what you should do: close the material and try to explain what you have just learned from memory, without looking at it.
paragraphs.zh: 因此，读完一段内容之后，你可以这样做：合上材料，不再查看原文，尝试凭自己的记忆解释刚刚学到的知识。

paragraphs.en: Then write down everything you can remember.
paragraphs.zh: 接着，把自己能够回忆起来的所有内容都写下来。

paragraphs.en: You are going to struggle, and that is precisely the point.
paragraphs.zh: 这个过程可能会让你感到吃力，而这恰恰是它的意义所在。

paragraphs.en: Every time your brain has to work to retrieve information, you are giving yourself another opportunity to strengthen that memory.
paragraphs.zh: 每当大脑努力提取信息时，你实际上就在为强化这段记忆创造新的机会。

paragraphs.en: Try doing this again one day later, and then once more a week later. By combining active recall with spaced practice, you can make what you have learned much easier to remember over time.
paragraphs.zh: 可以在一天后重新进行一次回忆练习，再过一周进行第三次。将主动回忆与间隔练习结合起来，能够帮助你在更长时间内牢固地记住所学内容。
